resources.string: Choose a Meesho shipping-label PDF. Each page\'s shipping label and invoice are cropped and placed side by side on a 5×3in page, ready for a label printer.
Choose a Flipkart (E-Kart) shipping-label PDF. You get two files: the labels, cropped tight on their own ~3×5in page each; and the Tax Invoices (when printed below a label), merged two per A4 page.
